fixes.en: Live preview now works for a main document in a subfolder, such as cv/sop/sop.tex, and lays it out the same as the real build: its bibliography, \input files and figures resolve from the document's own folder.
fixes.zh: 实时预览现在支持位于子文件夹中的主文档（例如 cv/sop/sop.tex），排版与正式编译一致：参考文献、\input 文件和图片都从文档所在的文件夹解析。

fixes.en: The selected file in the file tree no longer flickers while you scroll.
fixes.zh: 文件树中选中的文件在滚动时不再闪烁。
